children.content: 一家成立 50 多年的意大利企业的历史

children.name: page-company-para-0
children.content: 企业 历史 企业系统 Italian Style 我们的认证 Governance 03:24 一家成立 50 多年的意大利企业的历史 FPT INDUSTRIE S.p.A. 自 1969 年以来一直为通用机械行业和模具制造行业生产数控镗床和铣床。从成立到现在， FPT INDUSTRIE S.p.A. 显著增加和巩固了其在意大利和国际市场的影响力，肯定了其品牌作为技术、精度和可靠性的代名词。企业的发展并没有随着时间的推移而放缓，这证实了其生产和商业战略的成功。

children.name: page-company-para-1
children.content: 1997 年， FPT INDUSTRIE S.p.A. 完成了对 CASTEL 公司的收购，它是移动立柱式镗床生产行业的意大利知名品牌，从而使我们扩大了生产范围，并在竞争中扩大了市场份额。 FPT INDUSTRIE S.p.A. 的成功归功于创新理念的不断产生，尤其是在改进流程、产品、服务及其企业形象的背景下不断进行研究工作。这项研究特别关注市场需求，同时对最终客户服务可靠性的重要性非常敏感。

children.name: page-company-para-2
children.content: FPT 是生产中大型镗床和铣床的领先企业。 FPT INDUSTRIE S.p.A. 配备了极为现代化的工厂和非常先进的生产设备，提供具有非常高技术含量的机器，能够完成和改进与最重要、最精细的机械加工相关的传统生产工艺。

children.name: page-company-para-3
children.content: 超过 280 名机械、电气、电子专业技术人员和程序员参与车间内极高质量产品的组装，旨在确保高生产灵活性。

children.name: page-company-para-4
children.content: 凭借在该领域最先进的模拟技术和所积累的经验，FPT 能够响应客户的各种生产需求，并优化新投资的技术和经济效益。

The history of Warcom , founded in 1979, began some 20 years earlier, in 1959 to be precise, when- Giovanni Robazza decided that there was an opportunity to carve out a space for himself in the market for sheet metal processing machines , and shears in particular. From that intuition came the first mechanical cast iron shear and the Robazza/Romea brand. It was from the ashes of the Romea brand in 1979 that Giovanni’s son Walter founded Warcom, which took up Romea’s historical ideas but brought an absolutely industrial vision of the product and its production cycle. Warcom thus quickly became synonymous with CNC-controlled machine presses, press brakes and shears . To which have been added over time the laser machines (2011) and more recently the laser machine dedicated to pipe processing , making Warcom also a company that has few equals in terms of offer range and ability to cover several technological areas precisely to find the best possible solutions. This turns out to be an advantage both in the supply of standardised machines and systems, and in cases where it is necessary to provide a real work cell made to measure and equipped with all the interlocking systems and automation necessary for large-scale production.

children.name: page-warcom-news-para-1
children.content: Today, Warcom is managed by Alberto and Paolo, Walter’s sons, who represent the third generation of the family in the machine tool industry.

children.name: page-warcom-news-para-2
children.content: With a healthy turnover and a commitment to continue growing by expanding Warcom’s footprint in the sheet metal processing sector, the Adro-based company is a magnificent example of what a made in Italy product means today. Because at Warcom, the product is designed and then created in all its components.

children.name: page-warcom-news-para-3
children.content: An integrated production cycle which makes the Brescia company a very interesting example of verticalisation which, having control of all production phases, manages to guarantee a qualitative status that is decidedly above average , not only with regards to the product in the literal sense, but also for the management of production times and consequently programming. A significant guarantee for those who decide to invest in a new machine.

children.name: page-warcom-news-para-4
children.content: One of the choices that distinguish companies lies in the decision to embrace the make or buy philosophy. That is, whether one prefers to produce as many components as possible in-house or whether the choice is to buy the different parts on the market needed for a product and then simply assemble them in-house. Warcom, as we were saying, has embraced the make philosophy, and in order to honour this choice the company has equipped itself with the best tools to guarantee its high quality standard. "The choice of keeping all production processes in-house is not always the most economical, but it is certainly the one that allows us to have the best quality result, also thanks to the fact that we can directly monitor every single step. In short, spend a little more to get a better quality and more consistent product. One of our strengths lies in the decision to equip ourselves with the best tools necessary to achieve the highest quality in our products."

The history of Warcom , founded in 1979, began some 20 years earlier, in 1959 to be precise, when- Giovanni Robazza decided that there was an opportunity to carve out a space for himself in the market for sheet metal processing machines , and shears in particular. From that intuition came the first mechanical cast iron shear and the Robazza/Romea brand. It was from the ashes of the Romea brand in 1979 that Giovanni’s son Walter founded Warcom, which took up Romea’s historical ideas but brought an absolutely industrial vision of the product and its production cycle. Warcom thus quickly became synonymous with CNC-controlled machine presses, press brakes and shears . To which have been added over time the laser machines (2011) and more recently the laser machine dedicated to pipe processing , making Warcom also a company that has few equals in terms of offer range and ability to cover several technological areas precisely to find the best possible solutions. This turns out to be an advantage both in the supply of standardised machines and systems, and in cases where it is necessary to provide a real work cell made to measure and equipped with all the interlocking systems and automation necessary for large-scale production.

children.name: page-warcom-news-para-1
children.content: Today, Warcom is managed by Alberto and Paolo, Walter’s sons, who represent the third generation of the family in the machine tool industry.

children.name: page-warcom-news-para-2
children.content: With a healthy turnover and a commitment to continue growing by expanding Warcom’s footprint in the sheet metal processing sector, the Adro-based company is a magnificent example of what a made in Italy product means today. Because at Warcom, the product is designed and then created in all its components.

children.name: page-warcom-news-para-3
children.content: An integrated production cycle which makes the Brescia company a very interesting example of verticalisation which, having control of all production phases, manages to guarantee a qualitative status that is decidedly above average , not only with regards to the product in the literal sense, but also for the management of production times and consequently programming. A significant guarantee for those who decide to invest in a new machine.

children.name: page-warcom-news-para-4
children.content: One of the choices that distinguish companies lies in the decision to embrace the make or buy philosophy. That is, whether one prefers to produce as many components as possible in-house or whether the choice is to buy the different parts on the market needed for a product and then simply assemble them in-house. Warcom, as we were saying, has embraced the make philosophy, and in order to honour this choice the company has equipped itself with the best tools to guarantee its high quality standard. "The choice of keeping all production processes in-house is not always the most economical, but it is certainly the one that allows us to have the best quality result, also thanks to the fact that we can directly monitor every single step. In short, spend a little more to get a better quality and more consistent product. One of our strengths lies in the decision to equip ourselves with the best tools necessary to achieve the highest quality in our products."

children.name: page-mecspe-2026-para-1
children.content: At our booth, you will have the opportunity to engage directly with FPT experts and explore our full portfolio of CNC solutions for milling, boring, and turning . Our machines are engineered to deliver maximum accuracy and reliability to production processes across strategic sectors, including general machining, mold & die, automotive, marine, power generation, earthmoving, and aerospace, providing concrete answers to the most complex manufacturing challenges.

children.name: page-mecspe-2026-para-2
children.content: At MECSPE 2026, you can discover TUDX , FPT’s new 5-axis universal head designed to maximize your production flexibility. Thanks to the exclusive Automatic Accessories Change system, you can automatically switch between dedicated accessories for milling, turning, grinding, and FSW welding, eliminating manual intervention and optimizing production cycle times.

children.name: page-mecspe-2026-para-3
children.content: FPT offers dedicated systems for Friction Stir Welding (FSW) , a fast, automated, and eco-sustainable solid-state welding process. This technology enables the joining of heterogeneous metals (such as aluminum, copper, and magnesium) and varying thicknesses without the use of filler material. FSW technology can be directly integrated into FPT machine tools, drastically expanding machining possibilities and operational versatility within a single setup.
